commits.patch:
diff --git a/src/knownhost.c b/src/knownhost.c
index c9851b5..e1250ce 100644
--- a/src/knownhost.c
+++ b/src/knownhost.c
@@ -868,7 +868,7 @@ static int knownhost_line_legacy(LIBSSH2_KNOWNHOSTS *hosts,
             char hostbuf[256];
 
             /* make sure we do not overflow the buffer */
-            if(namelen >= sizeof(hostbuf) - 1)
+            if(namelen > 255)
                 return ssh2_err(hosts->session,
                                 LIBSSH2_ERROR_METHOD_NOT_SUPPORTED,
                                 "Failed to parse known_hosts line "

coupling: The IPv6 maintenance commit changes the legacy known-host scratch buffer from 256 to 255 bytes and adjusts its sizeof-derived check, preserving the original accepted lengths safely. The later tidy-up commit permits 255-byte legacy hostnames, which fit its original 256-byte buffer. Together, a 255-byte bracketed host-and-port entry passes the later check, fills the reduced buffer, and writes its NUL byte one past the end. The repair requires reconciling the input limit with the storage capacity across the two commits; neither isolated edit produces the overflow.
